choices.content: The number of books in the bookstore before the new stock arrived
The total number of books sold and received
The number of books currently in the bookstore

question.prompt: A bookstore originally has \(m\) books. After selling \(n\) books, it receives 5 more books. What does the algebraic expression \(m-n+5\) represent?

solutions.explanation: \(m-n\) is the number of books remaining after the sale. Adding the 5 newly received books gives the number of books currently in the bookstore.
solutions.title: Track the inventory changes
